cohort: The study included 160 pregnant women admitted to a tertiary care center, divided into three groups based on their Amniotic Fluid Index (AFI) scores.
finding: Oligohydramnios (AFI < 5cm) was associated with significantly higher rates of induction of labor, emergency cesarean section, and adverse neonatal outcomes including NICU admission, respiratory distress, and birth asphyxia.
mod_finding: The oligohydramnios group had a higher rate of induction of labor (66.7%) and showed statistically significant differences in indications for emergency cesarean section compared to groups with normal or borderline AFI.
